intro.h2: Everything for the remodel, in one showroom
paragraphs: New Creation Kitchen, Bath and Flooring is the kitchen and bath showroom Johnson City homeowners and contractors use to pick out a whole project at once. One customer chose all her tile, grout, shower enclosure and fixtures in a single stop, and her contractor bought his materials there too.

The showroom is the word that comes up most in their Google reviews, mentioned by ten different reviewers, and one calls it absolutely stunning. Customers also mention staff who explain options in detail, compare quality and pricing side by side, review products thoroughly and answer questions quickly. On Thursdays it stays open until 7 PM.

services.h2: What you can choose at the showroom

items.name: Kitchen design and cabinets
items.blurb: Walk through full kitchen displays and work with the sales and design team on layout and style. A Google reviewer says the staff will help design your space, and their Facebook page invites homeowners to start planning that kitchen remodel they have been putting off.

image.alt: Kitchen display with dark cabinets, glass-front cabinets and a veined white countertop

items.name: Countertops
items.blurb: Compare countertop materials and colors next to the cabinets you are considering. Kitchen countertop choices are a recurring topic in their Google reviews, and the team has posted on Facebook about why customers choose them for countertops.

image.alt: Kitchen with white cabinets, speckled granite countertops, stainless appliances and wood floors

items.name: Bathroom tile, fixtures and vanities
items.blurb: Bath remodels are a regular reason people visit. Pick tile, grout, fixtures and vanities from the displays. Tile selection comes up in reviews, and the showroom has a wall of vanity and mirror displays to compare finishes in person.

image.alt: Showroom aisle of bathroom vanity displays with mirrors, sconces and white countertops

items.name: Frameless shower doors and enclosures

items.name: Flooring

about.h2: About New Creation Kitchen, Bath and Flooring
about.text: New Creation Kitchen, Bath and Flooring is a kitchen, bath and flooring showroom at 800 Valley Plaza in Johnson City, New York. It opened in spring 2026, and five weeks after the grand opening the team posted that the response from homeowners and contractors had been tremendous. The store has kept growing since, adding to its sales and design team. Customers mention Derek by name, and Casey Joseph Difulvio is listed as an officer of the company. Homeowners come in for design help and selections; contractors come for materials.
about.owner_role: Listed as officer in the business listing quoted with the email address; Derek (also spelled Derrick in one review) is named by customers

image.alt: Inside the New Creation showroom: vanity and mirror displays under a pressed-tin style ceiling

steps.title: Come in or call
steps.text: Visit 800 Valley Plaza Ste 1 during opening hours, including Thursday evenings until 7 PM, or call (607) 238-0366 first.

steps.title: Talk through your project
steps.text: Tell the team about your kitchen, bath or floor. Reviewers say the staff will help design your space and explain each option in detail.

steps.title: Compare and choose
steps.text: Look at quality and pricing side by side, then pick cabinets, countertops, tile, grout, fixtures, enclosures and flooring in one visit.

steps.title: Your contractor picks up
steps.text: Your contractor can get the materials here as well, including Schluter products and tile tools from the contractor desk.

service_area.h2: Visit us in Johnson City, New York
service_area.text: The showroom is at 800 Valley Plaza Ste 1, Johnson City, NY 13790. Johnson City is the town on the Google profile and on the store's Facebook posts. Homeowners from the area planning a kitchen, bath or flooring project and contractors buying materials can stop in Monday to Saturday, or call (607) 238-0366 to ask about a product before making the trip.

items.a: Google lists Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, Thursday from 9 AM to 7 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 2 PM. The showroom is closed on Sunday. Thursday evening is a good time to come in after work.

items.q: Can someone help me design my kitchen or bath?
items.a: Yes. A Google reviewer wrote that the staff will help design your space, and the store has a dedicated sales and design team. Bring room measurements, photos of the space and any ideas you have saved, and the team can walk you through cabinets, counters and tile.

items.q: Can my contractor buy materials here?
items.a: Yes. One customer's contractor got all the materials for her bath remodel at the showroom. The contractor desk stocks the full Schluter line, including shower trays, board, niches, tile trim, mortar and Ditra heat kits, plus Pearl Abrasives tile saw and grinder blades.

Yes, flooring is part of the store's name. A reviewer said the knowledgeable staff explained flooring options in detail, with choices at different levels of quality and price. Visit the showroom to see the samples in person and compare them against your cabinet and tile choices.

Yes. Their Facebook page says they offer a full selection of frameless shower doors. A customer remodeling her bath picked her shower enclosure along with tile, grout and fixtures in the same visit. Ask the team which styles fit the size of your shower opening.

final_cta.h2: Start your kitchen or bath at Valley Plaza
final_cta.text: Stop in to see the displays or call to ask the team a question.
